title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Leaving the House 😂 #adhd #shorts
desc:
Keys → phone → wallet → back inside → keys again. 😂 Can you relate? Drop your loop in the comments 👇

Tip: keep one "launch pad" by the door. Keys, wallet, phone live there. Nowhere else.

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdproblems #adhdhumor #shorts #relatable #funny

beats.say: Here's how a normal person leaves the house. Keys. Wallet. Phone. Out the door. Done.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now here's me. I'm already late. So I'm moving fast.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Where are my keys? They were right here. They are always right here.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Found them. In the fridge. Don't ask.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Got the wallet. Out the door. Car's running. Where's my phone?
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I'm calling my phone. From my phone. Because I'm holding it.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Okay. Really leaving now. Did I turn the stove off? I didn't even cook today. But did I?
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Did I turn the stove off?

beats.say: While I'm in here, might as well grab a snack. And water the plant. And read this one letter.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Made it to the car. Where are my keys? I put them down. To grab the snack.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Finally. Keys, wallet, phone. Driving. Halfway down the road, did I lock the door?
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I did. I always do. I still had to go check.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: I did. Still had to check.

beats.say: Total time to leave the house. Forty one minutes. And I'm still late.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Here's why. Your brain holds about one thing at a time, and every new thing knocks the old one out. So give your stuff one home. One spot by the door. Keys, wallet, phone. Every single time.
beats.cap2: Tip: one launch pad by the door. Keys, wallet, phone live there.

beats.say: How many trips back inside did it take you today? Tell me in the comments.
